items.t: Said Elon Musk should "absolutely" consider moving Twitter from California to Texas.
items.q: Texas State Representative Tan Parker told FOX Business that Musk should "absolutely" consider moving Twitter from California to Texas, just like he did with Tesla.

items.t: Said Texas is the most business friendly state in America and is open for business.
items.q: Texas is the most business friendly state in America, that we are open for business,

items.t: Said Texas is a low tax state with no state income tax.
items.q: We are a low tax state. We have no state income tax. Pretty extraordinary environment.

record.t: Applauded the signing of SB 1057 on business registrations and capital market formation.
record.q: Senator Tan Parker applauds signing of SB 1057 to position Texas as the national leader for business registrations and capital market formation

record.t: Introduced legislation on the innovation, efficiency, and ethical use of artificial intelligence by government.
record.q: Senator Tan Parker Introduces Legislation to Promote the Innovation, Efficiency, and Ethical Use of Artificial Intelligence by Government

record.t: Filed legislation to prohibit the dismemberment and leasing of unclaimed bodies.
record.q: Senator Tan Parker Files Legislation to Prohibit the Dismemberment and Leasing of Unclaimed Bodies - Ensuring Dignity for the Deceased

record.t: Filed the Texas Capital Markets Package, consisting of SJR 50, SB 1056, SB 1057 and SB 1058.
record.q: Senator Tan Parker Files Texas Capital Markets Package --  SJR 50, SB 1056, SB 1057, SB 1058

record.t: Filed SB 780, his first bill to establish a Homeland Security Division.
record.q: Senator Tan Parker Files First Bill to Establish Homeland Security Division – SB 780

record.t: Filed legislation to fight human trafficking.
record.q: Senator Tan Parker Files Legislation to Fight Human Trafficking

record.t: Was elected unanimously by his colleagues as chair of the House Republican Caucus during the 84th and 85th legislative sessions.
record.q: His leadership was instrumental in the unanimous election by his colleagues as chair of the House Republican Caucus during the 84th and 85th legislative sessions.

record.t: Served in the Texas House from 2007 to 2023 and in the Texas Senate from 2023 to the present.
record.q: Legislative Experience: House Member, 2007-2023; Senate Member: 2023 - present

record.t: Served as Chair of the Senate Republican Caucus, Chair of the Senate Committee on Transportation, and Vice Chair of the Senate Committee on Criminal Justice.
record.q: Now serving in the Texas Senate, Tan has continued his record of leadership, serving as Chair of the Senate Republican Caucus, Chair of the Senate Committee on Transportation, and Vice Chair of the Senate Committee on Criminal Justice.

record.t: Sponsored Senate Bill 36, which passed the Senate 26-4 and would create a homeland security office in the state Department of Public Safety.
record.q: Republican state Sen. Tan Parker’s Senate Bill 36 passed Thursday in a 26-4 vote. The bill would create a homeland security office in the state Department of Public Safety

record.t: Co-authored Senate Bill 15, which restricts participation in women's sports at colleges and universities in Texas to an individual's biological gender.
record.q: Republican state Sen. Tan Parker, a co-author of Senate Bill 15, was present during the Aug. 7 ceremonial signing of the new piece of legislation
